vendor: Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.
product_family: DeepSeek LLM platform with consumer chat (chat.deepseek.com), open-source models, and API platform. Products include DeepSeek V4, V3.2, V3, Coder V2, R1, Math, and VL variants.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Privacy policy and transparency documentation contain no mention of SOC 2 Type 1 certification.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Privacy policy and transparency documentation contain no mention of SOC 2 Type 2 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Privacy policy and model disclosure documentation contain no mention of ISO 27001 certification.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: The vendor appoints an Article 27 representative: 'We value your privacy and your rights as a data subject and have therefore appointed Prighter Group with its local partners as our privacy representative.' The policy states data is stored in China ('we directly collect, process and store your Personal Data in People's Republic of China') and offers only a generic transfer safeguard ('Where required, we will use appropriate safeguards for transferring Personal Data outside of certain countries'); no Standard Contractual Clauses or specific adequacy mechanism is named. Appointing an EU representative does not by itself establish GDPR compliance, and the vendor makes no compliance claim.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No Business Associate Agreement (BAA) offered. Company privacy policy makes no mention of HIPAA compliance.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. DeepSeek does not hold FedRAMP certification. (AWS Bedrock may be FedRAMP authorized separately, but this is not a DeepSeek certification.)

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Transparency documentation and model cards do not reference ISO 42001 certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: User input may be used during optimization training phase. Users can opt out of data usage for model training. When user data is incorporated, DeepSeek applies 'secure encryption, strict de-identification, and anonymization' to make it unlinked to specific individuals. Company states it does not use data for user profiling or personalized recommendations.

security.name: Data Protection Standards
security.value: Commercially reasonable technical, administrative, and physical security measures claimed. No specific standards or audit certifications documented.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: When user input is used for training, 'secure encryption' is applied along with de-identification and anonymization. Company acknowledges 'no Internet or email transmission is ever fully secure or error free.'

security.name: API Cache Isolation
security.value: Each user's cache is isolated and logically invisible to others. Unused cache entries automatically cleared after period.

security.name: Content Moderation
security.value: Technical filters automatically remove hate speech, pornography, violence, spam, or potential infringement. Combined algorithmic and manual review to identify and reduce statistical biases.

products.name: DeepSeek Chat (Consumer)
products.data_scope: Processes user prompts and chat history. Personal data collected: username, email, phone, date of birth, device/network info, keystroke patterns.
products.notes: Web and mobile versions. Data stored in China. User has right to opt-out of training data usage.

products.name: DeepSeek API Platform
products.data_scope: Processes API requests and payloads. Same data residency and training policies as consumer product.
products.notes: Context caching available. Each user's cache isolated. Designed for enterprise integration but no formal compliance certifications.

products.name: Open-Source Models (V4, V3, Coder, R1, Math, VL)
products.data_scope: Model weights only; no data collection in self-hosted deployment. Users responsible for their own deployment security.
products.notes: Available via HuggingFace and GitHub. Self-hosting eliminates data residency concerns but compliance responsibility falls on deploying organization.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (consumer) + pay-per-token API pricing. Significantly cheaper than OpenAI/Anthropic.
compare.data_residency: China (primary). Data stored in People's Republic of China with potential export to other locations.

flags: GDPR non-compliance risk: data is stored in China, subject to China's National Intelligence Law, which compels government data access without user consent or transparency. No Standard Contractual Clauses or explicit adequacy safeguards are mentioned in the privacy policy.
Not suitable for regulated industries (healthcare/HIPAA, government/FedRAMP, financial/PCI DSS) due to lack of certifications and data residency in China.
Zero formal security certifications (no SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, or CSA STAR). Relies on unaudited 'commercially reasonable measures' claim.
U.S. government restrictions: DeepSeek banned from some state networks and federal agencies due to geopolitical and security concerns.

Training data practices: Users can opt-out but opt-out mechanism and implementation details not explicitly documented. Company states it can use user input for optimization training with anonymization.
Transparency gaps: No published security audit reports, no third-party compliance verification, no trust center with detailed controls documentation.
